Gossip peer GUI state, metrics aggregation, WebSocket updates, and viewport handling.

# Purpose
This C file implements the peer GUI state manager for the gossip view. It allocates and joins the shared memory context `fd_gui_peers_ctx_t`, builds the live peer table, bandwidth tracking table, and socket and pubkey maps, and keeps them in sync with gossip contact-info updates, vote updates, and message traffic. It also collects gossip and network health metrics from the topology, computes per-peer rates, and prepares the data that the GUI uses to show peer status and bandwidth.

The file also handles the WebSocket control path for the peer page. It parses JSON requests with `cJSON`, supports `query_sort` and `query_scroll`, maintains one viewport per WebSocket connection, and sends table updates and broadcasts when peer data changes. In addition, it manages round-robin refresh of connected clients, updates the visible peer list at fixed intervals, and sends gossip statistics to clients through the HTTP server interface.
